keyFindings.description: A fragment's label comes from `git log -1 --diff-filter=A` without --follow, so a renamed fragment gets the release after the rename, not the release that shipped it. The new refusal at :502 tells people to rename a refused entry, and a refused entry reaches main (no PR check) after its release is cut. Reproduced: fragment added at M, tagged p-v1.0.0, renamed, then p-v1.1.0 -> fold-plan labels it 1.1.0; with --follow the add commit is M. Fix: --follow, plus a test of a fragment renamed after its release.
